text: The English couple Tom and Evelyn, [expecting their third child|who_suffers|expectant parents], take a holiday on [an island|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] where the only people they meet are grim-faced, silent children. Slowly they learn that [the children have murdered nearly every adult|threat|dangerous children] there. A single look is enough to [turn other children to their side|rules|it passes to others], and the couple must decide whether they can bring themselves to kill a child to survive.
